name: RAG-LLM-Eval
description: NumPy · sentence-transformers · HuggingFace Datasets — RAG techniques measured as retrieval, on 14,602 real HotpotQA passages, with no language model in the loop. Retrieving smaller chunks made it worse; multi-query fusion made it worse; a second retrieval round with no reasoner was worth +7.1 points on bridge questions.
